text:
Highly recommended. Everything was very transparent with no hidden fees, which I really appreciated.
The dentist, Thida, was professional, honest, and took the time to explain everything clearly. I went in because of a small discomfort in one tooth, and the whole experience was smooth from start to finish. The reception was also very warm and welcoming.
If you’re a tourist or expat in Bangkok and need urgent or routine dental care, this is definitely a place you can trust.
On top of that, the clinic is very clean and well organized.
